question: Which of these books is a memoir by neurosurgeon Paul Kalanithi detailing his life and battle with lung cancer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**When Breath Becomes Air'**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Paul Sudhir Arul Kalanithi:

 
 
• It was an American neurosurgeon and writer.
 
• His book When Breath Becomes Air is a memoir about his life and illness with stage IV metastatic lung cancer.
 
• It was posthumously published by Random House in January 2016.
